proof_scope: In progress. R1795 proves that an open set O of finite positive Haar volume w, bounded in Box(Q), with E(O,O)>=w^3/L for positive finite L, has the explicit popular-product region C={1_O*1_O>w/(2L)}. It is nonempty open precompact, its closure lies in Box(2Q^2), H(C)<=2Lw, and the actual pairs in O x O with product in C have measure at least w^2/(2L). Lower semicontinuity follows directly from Fatou; product mass equals pair measure by a proved convolution-of-restrictions identity. The actual smoothed nonflattening iterates give this relation with L=8(64N^4)^2/theta^2 and prove L>=1 and finite, preserving the dyadic level, volume window and arbitrary small enlargement error. Weak BSG selection, small-product/approximate-group extraction, metric transfer, SL2 growth/escape, strict flattening and unconditional paid padding remain unproved.
